description: Commission of Elections - Notice under Registration of Electors Act. No. 44 of 1980 as amended by the Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Act, No. 10 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses electoral processes under the Registration of Electors Act and its Special Provisions Act. It outlines procedures for internally displaced persons and their children to register as electors, announces application dates for supplementary voter registration, and is issued by the Election Commission. The content focuses entirely on voter registration matters, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
